comparedSystems.description: DSH Compaction Weave 0.3.2 (Stage-1 local observation masking + XML provenance isolation + key:value progress + CommonMark 0–3 space heading tolerance + subject-bound audit)
DSH Compaction Weave 0.3.2-rc.4 baseline at commit a41b41a (no Stage-1 masking; legacy domain regex heuristics)
DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 built-in BasicCompactionEngine + ToolResultPruner with full stock 65,536 headroomTokens (no artificial output cap)
billion-context@0.1.216 local ACP HTTP proxy with unified x-acp-session header, ccr enabled, and natural <acp-nudge> autonomous compression

fairnessAndAntiDistortionControls: dsh-basic mounted with stock headroomTokens (65,536 vs earlier 22,000 test harness setting) and CHAT_MAX_TOKENS=16384 so GLM/Gemini/DeepSeek never hit artificial output truncation in w1.
billion-context mounted with a persistent header-injecting hop attaching x-acp-session per session across all turns and model switches plus ccr=true and autonomous <acp-nudge> handling.
Workloads use unique per-phase Node.js/SQL module implementations (100% distinct domain classes and functions, zero repetitive filler) and ambiguous fields explicitly permit null when unverified.
Models receive identical surface prompts, JSON schemas, and retry budgets via @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai over Magpie gateway.

gpt6AstraApiRestrictionNote.note: User invited GPT-6 Astra collaboration. On Magpie, auto/gpt-6-astra works natively in the official Codex CLI (used heavily for adversarial code and benchmark audits via MCP), but direct HTTP calls from non-Codex DSH clients return HTTP 403 ("This account only allows Codex official clients"); 2-2/gpt-6-astra returns HTTP 400 (no Responses upstream URL) and group/gpt-6.2-astra returns HTTP 404. Following strict no-spoofing guidelines, DSH HTTP benchmarks therefore ran GPT-6.1 Sol (2-2/gpt-6.1-sol in Suite A before 公益2 disabled chat completions; auto/gpt-6.1-sol in Suite C with 99.33%–99.46% KV cache verified by live probe).
